label: Arcade
blurb: Bright pastel village: chunky toon props, painted lawns, critter enemies and fantasy weapons.

player.label: Villager hero
player.note: Toon villager-adventurer (tools/blender/v2/arcade/hero.py): 1.8 m to the crown plus spiky hair, 65 Mixamo bones, Hero_Idle/_Walk/_Run/_Jump/_Interact and the genre clips Hero_Attack/_AimIdle/_AimRun/_Hit/_Death/_Cheer at 30 fps, in place; a Grip_R socket on the right hand holds the staff.

desert.label: Desert oasis
desert.blurb: A sun-baked oasis town: plaster houses with parapets and domes, palms round the water, a market under striped awnings.

snow.label: Snow village
snow.blurb: A cozy alpine village: log cabins and timber lodges under thick snow, a bell tower over the square, snowy pines and a frozen pond.
